mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies and a temperature of 45 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park.

The City of Verona has updated their zoning ordinances to ensure property development matches our community standards, and residents are reminded that polling locations for upcoming elections have been updated, so please check the city website to confirm where you should vote.
We have a packed schedule starting today with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus yoga classes happening tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving behavior while transporting students.
Stop by for a scoop of today's delicious Mint Cookie flavor; the shop opens today at 10:00 AM.
